title: Risk Evaluation and Surveillance of Complications in UppEr GI and HPB Surgery
summary: Das Ziel dieser Studie ist zu untersuchen, ob bei großen bauchchirurgischen Eingriffen (Leber-, Bauchspeicheldrüsen- und Speiseröhrenchirurgie) im Zeitraum nach der Operation durch eine automatische Alarmierung anhand definierter Grenzwerte (Early-Warning-Score) auf Basis einer zusätzlichen, kontinuierlichen Überwachung der Kreislauffunktionen (Blutdruck, Sauerstoffsättigung, Pulsfrequenz) sowie die tägliche Visite eines Intensivmediziners mindestens bis zum dritten postoperativen Tag zu einer Reduktion des Schweregrades von postoperativer Komplikationen, erfasst anhand des Comprehensive Complication Index, bis zum 30. postoperativen Tag führen können.

interventions.name: In the intervention group, patients are admitted to special monitor beds in the normal ward. Vital parameters (RR, HR, AF, SpO2) are continuously recorded via inpatient monitoring (MX450 incl. Intellivue X3 Box, Philips GmbH, Hamburg). Patients receive standard medical care in the normal surgical ward, i.e., daily rounds by surgical ward physicians, treatment according to the ERAS concept (25), nursing rounds (spot checks) once per shift, further treatment if complications are detected, and consultative, exclusively event-related

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Consent to participate in the study
- Legal capacity of the patient
- Elective surgery on the pancreas, liver, or esophagus
- Transfer from an anesthesiological monitoring unit (PACU/IMC/IOI) to a normal ward if normal ward criteria are met
Exclusion criteria:
- Withdrawal of consent
- Desire to terminate the study
- Refusal by patient
- Language barrier
- Intensive inpatient therapy due to organ failure prior to randomization
- Injury to both ear canals, hearing aids on both sides
- Presence of a palliative treatment situation
